title: Pre-Live Owner Handoff & Certification Readiness
note: Operational handoff only. No secret, transcript, audio or model output appears here or may be added.

handoff_findings.summary: All three deployment runbooks are Dograh-era and SUPERSEDED
handoff_findings.detail: platform/DEPLOY.md, platform/ORACLE_DEPLOY.md and platform/scripts/oracle_setup.sh deploy the retired engine plus coturn. Oracle/host/TLS knowledge is reusable (ORACLE_DEPLOY Phases 1-5); bring-up is not. Stop before Phase 6.

handoff_findings.summary: The media UDP port range cannot be pinned from configuration
handoff_findings.detail: aioice 0.10.2 binds local_addr=(address, 0) at aioice/ice.py:984 - the OS chooses the port - and neither aioice nor aiortc exposes a port-range option. The firewall must permit the host ephemeral UDP range, or the operator narrows net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range first. The old 49152-49200 range is coturn's and does not apply.

handoff_findings.summary: No systemd unit and no TLS wiring exist for the first-party application
handoff_findings.detail: certbot produces a certificate; nothing connects it to the app. Choose uvicorn --ssl-keyfile/--ssl-certfile or a TLS-terminating reverse proxy. No reverse-proxy architecture is mandated by any existing deployment document.

handoff_findings.summary: No smoke-test utterance was documented anywhere; one is now defined
handoff_findings.detail: The SPEC's Hinglish phrases are a Phase-2 evaluation concept, not a pipeline smoke. A short deterministic English utterance is defined in the handoff and labelled as the smoke-test utterance.

owner_action_required: Python 3.12+ and uv installation on the host
TLS termination wiring (no repo mechanism exists)
systemd unit for service supervision (none exists)

health_check.credential_inference: The WebRTC app refuses to start without all three credentials and the voice id, so a /health that answers with transport=webrtc proves they resolved at startup.

E11-12.required: approved measurement definition (ADR-0053 decision) AND qualifying live evidence against a real recognizer

E11-15.required: Stage-2 + real browser + real providers + one scripted spoken call

R-66.required: the measurement decision; not merely a transcript arriving

R-68.required: genuinely multi-provider deployment; one live call proves mechanism, not deployed failover

adr_0053.decision_owed: whether speech_end -> stt_final becomes the authoritative reading of the A8 STT budget
adr_0053.note: SM5: ratification alone does not unblock E11-12

live_gate.rule: If any item is false, DO NOT START LIVE EXECUTION; the correct state is BLOCKED
